subject: Adoption of the Comprehensive Plan
overview: The Community Development Board voted to adopt Medford's new Comprehensive Plan after a final presentation on its goals and implementation strategy. The board also reviewed a preliminary proposal for an eight-story life sciences incubator on Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Comprehensive Plan Presentation and Adoption
items.summary: Consultants presented the final draft of the Comprehensive Plan, outlining five core themes—communication, supportive neighborhoods, vibrant places, access, and climate resiliency—and a ten-year implementation roadmap. The board voted to adopt the plan as the city's official planning document.

items.title: Informal Presentation: 243 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Verdant Bio presented a preliminary proposal for an eight-story biotech incubator building consisting of wet labs and office space with minimal on-site parking. Board members provided feedback regarding the building's scale, the visual impact of blank facades on neighboring residential areas, and the necessity of detailed shadow and traffic studies.

items.title: Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the November 10, 2022 meeting with a minor grammatical correction.
